description: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §4.2 requires each hook to set its own timeout and fail open (R3). Values are ceilings, not budgets: the probe's measured p95 is well under 1s (PERF-BUDGET.md), the PostToolUse settle leg reads one feed window and appends at most one line, the Stop audit runs the dedup pipeline (~3s cold on a 500-file tree), and SessionStart pays the daemon warm-up. A hook that hangs must end the session's wait, not own it.
